Usage: protonvpn [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Proton VPN command-line interface for Linux. 1.0.1

Commands:
  signin      Sign in to Proton VPN.
  signout     Sign out from Proton VPN.
  info        Display account information.
  connect     Connect to a Proton VPN server.
  disconnect  Disconnect from Proton VPN.
  status      Show current VPN connection status.
  countries   Discover countries.
  cities      Discover cities.
  config      Configure Proton VPN settings.
